messages:
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Staffing <recruiter@acme-talent.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Open req coverage and role triage for Q2 — prep for QBR

Team —

We need to lock the hiring plan we present at next week’s QBR (April 8). Attached is the headcount_report_q2.xlsx and an export of current open reqs (req_list_export.csv). I broadly propose the following triage:

- Approve backfills for critical infra/SRE and core infra product roles.
- Defer two mid-level product ICs (product manager II) if scope can shift to contractors.
- Hold all new exploratory ML hires until we have Optimize benchmarking completed (target end of May).

Please review the sheet and reply with: APPROVE / HOLD / DEFER next to the req IDs you own. If you need exceptions (freeze exceptions) call them out — include rationale and proposed timeline.

Quick asks:
- Laura: can you confirm SRE backfills and whether we can cover on-call with existing rotations for 6 weeks?
- Markus: which senior infra reqs are actively recruiting vs. pending approvals?
- Karthik: any capacity or budget constraints I should factor in?

I’ve looped Acme (recruiter) so they can prepare candidate buffers if we greenlight.

Thanks — I want a consolidated list by EOD tomorrow (Apr 2).

-David

--
David Kim
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference
[david_kim@redwood.com]

Attachments: headcount_report_q2.xlsx (spreadsheet), req_list_export.csv (csv)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

David —

APPROVE: SRE backfill REQ-2387 (senior SRE) and REQ-2421 (SRE). We cannot sustain additional on-call stretch beyond 6 weeks without hitting reliability targets; I can cover some shifts but would prefer the senior role fast-tracked.

HOLD: REQ-2470 (infra research engineer) — we should tie this to the Optimize milestone. If benchmarking slips, we deprioritize.

Action: I’ll ping Acme to ask for a shortlist of senior SREs (target 4 resumes by Apr 7).

Laura

Quick update from infra hiring funnel:
- REQ-2387 (senior SRE) — ACTIVE (2 onsites next week). Recommend APPROVE and expedite offer authority.
- REQ-2404 (senior infra eng, storage team) — PENDING APPROVAL (budget sign-off from finance). Recommend APPROVE as backfill priority #2 if we get sign-off by Apr 6.

Attached: sre_skill_matrix.pdf (skill overlap for candidates in pipeline).

Note: if we approve both 2387 and 2404, we should ask Recruiter to open a passive sourcing channel immediately — 6–8 week lead time for a clean hire at senior level.

David —

Couple of constraints to surface before we finalize:
- Budget: Q2 hiring budget is ~65% committed after current offer pipeline. We have limited headroom for new roles outside critical backfills.
- Forecast: If we approve both senior infra roles (REQ-2387, REQ-2404) we should mark two product PM IIs as DEFER (REQ-2499, REQ-2501). We can shift short-term product work to contractors for 8–12 weeks.
- Hiring lead time: senior infra roles average 7 weeks to fill; we should set an expected start window into Q3 for planning.

Recommendation: APPROVE REQ-2387 and REQ-2404 (contingent on finance sign-off) — DEFER REQ-2499 and REQ-2501.

Karthik

Thanks all — consolidated decisions and next steps below (we will include this summary in the QBR packet):

Decisions (final):
- APPROVE: REQ-2387 (senior SRE) — proceed to offer; Recruiter to prioritize.
- APPROVE (contingent): REQ-2404 (senior infra eng) — contingent on finance sign-off; target Apr 6 decision.
- DEFER: REQ-2455 (infra tools engineer), REQ-2499 (product PM II), REQ-2501 (product PM II).
- HOLD: REQ-2470 (infra research engineer) pending Optimize benchmarks.

Action items:
- Markus: coordinate with People Ops for expedited offer package and confirm interview feedback (due Apr 5).
- Laura: prepare on-call coverage plan for 6 weeks and confirm if an interim contractor is needed (due Apr 4).
- Karthik: update Q2 budget forecast with the contingent approval scenario and flag for finance (done by Apr 3 EOD).
- Recruiter (Acme): build a passive pipeline and submit 4–6 candidates for REQ-2387 by Apr 7.

If finance clears 2404 by Apr 6, I will route both reqs for final approval and sign-off. For the QBR slide deck, Evelyn — please include an appendix with the deferred reqs and expected re-evaluation window (Aug 2027).

I’ll submit the packet to the QBR doc today. If anyone needs a freeze exception for business-critical cases outside the list above, reply with specifics (impact, mitigation, timeline).

-David
